description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the API functionality related to time configuration periods such as getting and updating time period settings.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the TimeConfigPeriodAPI, including methods for testing 'getOne', 'update', 'delete', and validation rules related to time configuration periods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a time configuration period via the API.

methods.name: getOnePreHook
methods.description: A setup hook executed before 'getOne' tests, modifies configuration for testing.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a time configuration period via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete functionality is not implemented and should raise an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that validation rules for delete are not implemented and should raise an exception.
